attributes.action: Make all use of fireworks by the public illegal.
attributes.additional_details: Fireworks are hazardous in so many ways to so many people and animals and the sheer volume of use by the public these days is creating an exponential and widespread problem. As well as physical injuries and noise pollution the most under-reported issue is the cloud of smoke that hovers over towns and cities for days around 5th November and New Years Eve every year and the resultant reduction in air quality.
attributes.background: The law should be changed so that fireworks can only be used during organised displays. They should not be on sale to the general public.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
